national_ideas.scope_note: 国家传统、七项国家理念与野心；不含可选理念组、种族/政府加成。多套候选与条件分别列示，不视为同时叠加；形成时是否接受新理念由实际事件/决议与玩家选择决定。

description.text: 美丽的伊奥尚自古以来就有人类繁衍生息，而早在伟大的卡斯塔诺或达梅里亚共和国出现前，这里的管理者就一直是河流侏儒。几个世纪过去了，在我们的影响下，邻近的伦科里部落逐渐形成了独特而美丽的文化，这是我们两大种族文化的融合体。我们的语言融入了他们的语言，他们涌向我们的剧院，观看喜剧和戏剧。最重要的是，他们接受了我们的时尚：真正的伊奥尚人的标志是他们的红帽子，他们骄傲地戴着红帽子，就像他们的统治者一样。
description.text_en: Fair Iochand has teemed with humans from time immemorial, yet its stewards, since even before great Castanor, or the Damerian Republic, have been the Creek Gnomes. The passage of centuries has seen the neighbouring Lencori tribes grow, under our influence, into a unique and beautiful culture, a synthesis of the ways of our peoples. Our language finds its way into their speech, and they flock to our theatres for comedy and drama alike. Most significantly, they have embraced our fashion: the mark of a true Iochander is their red cap, worn with pride, just like their rulers.

description.text: 高贵的波特罗伊河流经伊奥尚的中心地带，它的河水支撑着整个国家。它不仅划分了北部国王领地和南部公爵领地的边界，还承载着波特纳姆和曲渠郡这两个王国商业中心的贸易。东面是小人国，西面是西海岸。埃兰提尔的重生带来了来自远方的异域商品，而这些商品必须经由我们这里流通。
description.text_en: The noble Portroy flows through the heart of Iochand, and its waters sustain the realm. Beyond demarcating the boundary between the demesne of the King in the north and that of the Duke in the south, it carries the trade of Portnamm and Turnwell, the twin hubs of commerce in the realm. To the east lies the Small Country, and beyond the Westcoast. The rebirth of Aelantir brings the promise of exotic goods from afar, and they must flow through us.

description.text: 美丽的黄宫（Gelpalaasd）自建成以来，一直闪耀着伊奥尚皇冠上明珠的光芒。这座宫殿由杰出的侏儒建筑师设计，由勤劳的伊奥尚工人建造，四面环绕着黄花，是王国人民的纪念碑。来自远近各地的贵族和达官显贵们都在谈论黄宫的奢华舞会，在黄色的宫殿装饰中，他们尽情享受着万花筒般的娱乐和颓废。
description.text_en: Since its construction, the beautiful Gelpalaasd, or Yellow Palace, has gleamed as the crown jewel of Iochand. Designed by brilliant Gnomish architects and constructed by their diligent Iochander crews, the palace stands as a monument to the people of the realm, surrounded on all sides by the yellow flowers for which it is named. Dignitaries and nobles from near and far speak of the extravagant balls of the Gelpalaasd, kaleidoscopic affairs of entertainment and decadence, ensconced in the yellow fabric of the palace decor.

description.text:
掠夺者到达坎诺后毫不留情，伊奥尚遭遇了与许多王国相同的命运。没过多久，野蛮的北方人就击溃了王国所能调集的许多部队，而人民却不愿参军保卫王国。宫廷中的伟大思想家和战略家们为重建军队的不可能计划苦苦思索，但毫无结果。宫廷小丑却提出一个更贴近民众的建议，那就是在王国各地上演一出简单的喜剧舞台剧。
《锡尔德托七人团》讲述的是由半身人队长阿诺尔·勇足率领的一支由三个侏儒和三个人类组成的伊奥尚杂牌军的故事。他们驻扎在锡尔德托郡的一个偏僻哨所，最先发现了一队打算趁国王的军队在北方作战时发动突然袭击的掠夺者。在叛军的夹击下，他们展开了一场游击战，利用诡计、陷阱和幻术，用智慧对抗笨拙残暴的北方人。该剧获得了巨大成功，无数伊奥尚人被欢乐与荣耀的新梦想激励，加入了国王的军队。随着时间的推移，该剧的受欢迎程度并未减退，反而被改编成各种媒介，从吟游诗人的歌曲到睡前故事，激励着每一代人保卫伊奥尚。
description.text_en:
The reavers showed no mercy upon their arrival in Cannor, and Iochand suffered the same fate as many realms. Before long, the savage northmen had crushed many of the forces the kingdom could muster, and the people would not rise to aid the realm. The great thinkers and strategists of the royal court toiled fruitlessly over impossible plans to rebuild the army, until insight suddenly struck in an unexpected place. The court jester suggested something more familiar to the people, a simple comedic stage play, to be shown all across the kingdom.
The Sildthol Seven follows the story of a ragtag band of Iochanders, three gnomes and three humans, led by the halfling captain Arnol Bravefoot. Stationed in a backwater outpost in the County of Sildthol, they are first to discover a company of reavers, intending a surprise attack while the King's army fought in the north. Stuck between a reaver and a hard place, they wage a campaign of guerilla warfare with tricks, traps, and illusion, leveraging their wits against the bumbling and brutish northmen. The production was a runaway success, and countless Iochanders enlisted in the King's army, energised by new dreams of fun and glory. The popularity of the play did not fade over time, and has been adapted to every medium from bard song to bedtime story, inspiring each new generation to defend Iochand.

description.text: 龙醒的浩劫几乎摧毁了戈莫的所有分支，只剩下两个，一个在尼姆斯科德岛上，另一个在王国最古老、最重要的城市波特纳姆。戈莫的分支保留了其独立于王室的地位，经过几个世纪的发展，它已经成为波特纳姆大学，从教授单纯的奇械术扩展到我们民族文化所孕育的更广泛的课程。演员和作家从四面八方赶来学习戏剧艺术，幕后的舞台工作人员则研究烟火和舞台效果的科学，将伊奥尚戏剧的创造力推向了新的高度。在乡村田园里，学者们尝试着令人眼花缭乱的奇械创新，不断努力提高伊奥尚的农业产量，使王国始终走在时代前沿。
description.text_en: The devastation of the Dragonwake destroyed all but two branches of the Gommo, one on the isle of Nimscodd, and the other in Portnamm, the oldest and most important city of the kingdom. The Gommo branch retained its independence from the crown, and the passage of centuries saw it grow into the University of Portnamm, expanding from artificery alone to include a broader curriculum born of the culture of our people. Actors and authors come from far and wide to learn the dramatic arts, and behind the curtain stagehands study the science of pyrotechnics and stage effects, pushing Iochander theatre to new heights of creativity. In the countryside's idyllic fields, scholars experiment with dazzling new innovations of artificery, ever striving to further augment Iochand's agricultural output and keep the kingdom on the cutting edge.

description.text: 坎诺王国的宫廷小丑们享有「小丑特权」，他们有权畅所欲言，甚至嘲笑他们的统治者。戴着面具的伊奥尚王家御用小丑，也即纳尔，在宫廷中也享有极高的声望，但君主们追求的不仅仅是娱乐。王家小丑的面具始终如一，但每次见面时，声音和举止都会改变，让廷臣们永远无法确定对方是做出不同的表演，还是干脆就是不同的小丑。在不同的时间，这两种情况都有，因为伊奥尚王家小丑最大的职责其实是充当王国的间谍主管，监管一个从王国众多演员队伍中挑选出来的间谍网。
description.text_en: The jesters of the realms of Cannor enjoy the "Jester's Privilege," granting them the right to speak freely, and even mock their ruler. Iochander's masked Royal Jester, the Naar, remains a position of great prestige within the court, but it is not entertainment alone the sovereigns seek. The Royal Jester's mask remains the same, but with each encounter, the voice changes, the mannerisms shift, and courtiers are never sure of whether the figure with whom they were speaking was a different act, or a different jester. Both have been true at different times, for the Royal Jester’s greatest role is that of the spymaster of Iochand, overseeing a network of spies harvested from the capable ranks of the kingdom's many troupes of actors.

description.text:
侏儒的红帽子在有记载的历史上一直存在，它深受伊奥尚-伦科里人的喜爱，以至于成为我们军装的一部分，我们的红帽士兵队伍高矮不一，一眼就能认出我们的军团。虽然王国粗鲁的敌人可能会嘲笑我们永恒的侏儒时尚，但绿帽士兵的出现会让他们胆寒。英勇的绿帽战士是我们的精锐部队，他们武装到牙齿，被训练成致命的机器，是士兵中的佼佼者，他们用自己的经验智取并战胜了伊奥尚的敌人，让所有敌军都感到恐惧。
不过话又说回来，在伊奥尚，一切并非都基于真实故事。绿帽军其实并不是一支精英部队，甚至不是军队的正式组成部分。事实上，绿帽会被授予给有表演艺术经验的士兵，并在军团中轮流佩戴，佩戴者的任务是通过讲述过去的荣耀、即兴嘲讽敌人和用希望之歌留住战友的心来娱乐他们的战友。绿帽的名声对佩戴者来说并不是秘密，他们以维持这种巨大的欺骗性为荣，希望敌人的疑虑能成为我军巧妙战术的契机，让他们像被打败一样毫无头绪。
description.text_en:
The red cap of the gnome, ever present throughout recorded history, is popular with the Iochander Lencori to the extent that it became part of our military uniform, and the sight of our ranks of red capped soldiers, heights varying wildly, identifies our regiments at a glance. While the kingdom's boorish foes may mock our timeless Gnomish fashion, the appearance of a green-capped soldier chills them to the bone. The gallant Greencaps, a company of elite warriors, armed to the teeth, and drilled into a lethal machine, stand as leaders amongst the rank and file, using their experience to outwit and outlast the enemies of Iochand, and striking fear into all who oppose them.
 But then again, not everything in Iochand is based on a true story. The Greencaps are not an elite order, or even a formal component of the army. In truth, the green caps are given to soldiers with experience in the performing arts, and rotate through the regiments, the wearer tasked with the honour of entertaining their comrades by telling tales of past glory, improvising ruthless mockery of their foes, and staying their hearts with songs of hope. The reputation of the green cap is no secret to its wearers, and they take pride in maintaining the great deception, in hopes that the doubts of the enemy may become opportunities for clever tactics, leaving them as clueless as they are defeated.

player_overview.avoid_if: 不愿处理附庸、殖民事件或较长经济铺垫的玩家。
player_overview.how_it_plays: 先取得形成资格，再经营龙海岸多族群和奇械产业，最后管理海外附庸与王国危机。
player_overview.overview: 伊奥尚曾是侏儒王室统治、侏儒与人类共居的龙海岸王国，1264年灭亡。1444年你要由合格前身重建它，再处理侏儒、人类和狗头人的关系，发展农业实验与奇械产业。后期殖民地和特殊附庸会让海外秩序反过来考验王权。
player_overview.recommended_for: 喜欢形成国、奇械经济、殖民和多族群政治的玩家。
signature_features: 灭亡王国复兴，可由多个合格前身形成。
侏儒君主制、族群关系与奇械农业实验并行。
北阿兰提尔殖民地可转成特殊属国，并引出后期事件。
player_overview.tagline: 重建侏儒王朝，把龙海岸的匠作与海外属国经营成一座新王国。

reasons: 侏儒王朝复国历史鲜明
农业奇械与经济任务有差异化
海外属国带来后期政治故事
warnings: 前身入口与事件条件需要辨认
旧玩家经验不等于现版规则

positive_indicators: 农业改良与部分狗头人容忍
values.rationale: 侏儒与人类共同建国、部分对狗头人的容忍和农业改良支持正面评价；海外附庸等级、贡赋与可能的文化改造限制更高分。殖民和君主制本身不直接扣分，关键在居民和属国的具体待遇，部分分支未全审。
red_flags: 海外附庸等级与贡赋可能压过地方利益
文化改造依赖分支条件
